accepted.quote: Description: A Vespasianic domus in Ostia Antica, built ca. 70-75 CE, situated outside the Porta Marina, and north of the continuation of the Decumanus Maximus. It had a slightly concave façade, comprising six shops and an entrance corridor leading to an interior peristyle garden. Representative point: longitude 12.285019, latitude 41.750659.
accepted.note: Built ca. 70-75 CE outside the Porta Marina; the start year is approximate.
